answer: Across sessions, an anomaly score accumulates: each deviation from the account's own pattern adds a little, each consistent session subtracts a little. When the score crosses a threshold, the account is challenged; a farm's accounts all drift upward together, which is visible in aggregate. Even a quiet dune gets heard, because consistency weighs patterns, not volume. From the marble to the willow, the same rule holds: no continuity, no trust, no exception.
